#Copilot Instructions - Merginton High School

- This is a Fast API Backend for managing school activities and student sign-ups. with canila JS/HTML frontend.
- The backend provides endpoints to list activities, get participants for an activity, and sign up students for activities.
- The frontend allows users to view available activities, see who has signed up, and register for activities through a simple interface.
- The project uses FastAPI for the backend and vanilla JavaScript/HTML for the frontend.
- The project structure includes a `src` directory for the backend code and a `static` directory for the frontend, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript assets.
